creation_policy.origin: New synthetic tasks authored solely from the user specification; generic fictional situations with no personal or project identifiers.
creation_policy.isolation: No skill versions, development tasks, outputs, grades, or existing holdouts read. Case text and content-specific review notes remain private and excluded from optimizer and public context.
creation_policy.validation: Author-side second-pass mathematical and internal-consistency review, schema and source-length checks, and exact-arithmetic sanity checks; no external reviewer or candidate model invoked.
creation_policy.reservation: Reserved sealed holdout. No candidate generations, evaluation runs, Claude calls, or grading performed; not released for current development grading.
